description: LEGACY wallet flow — new integrations should use create_account and launch_campaign (API key + prepaid balance, no wallet). Creates a new agent session, proving the wallet with a signature from get_session_nonce. Returns a sessionId and paymentRequired. While sessions are free (paymentRequired false), the response also carries the one-time accessToken for create_campaign, and no payment step follows. If paymentRequired is true, send the stated USDC amount to the treasury address on-chain, then call verify_payment with the transaction signature to receive the access token. The wallet you prove here becomes the campaign's creator, and is the only wallet that will be able to read its results from the dashboard.

message.description: Exact message string returned by get_session_nonce (must match byte for byte)

signature.description: Base58-encoded Ed25519 signature of the message returned by get_session_nonce

name: initialize_session
